rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Powershell_Encoded {
    meta:
        description = "Detects base64-encoded PowerShell invocation commonly used by Cobalt Strike"
        author = "SOC Team"
        threat_id = "T1059.001"
        malware_family = "CobaltStrike"
    strings:
        $beacon1 = "powershell -nop -exec bypass -enc" wide ascii
        $beacon2 = "IEX(New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString" wide ascii
        $beacon3 = { 65 00 6D 00 73 00 69 00 } // "Amsi" in UTF-16
    condition:
        any of ($beacon*)
}

arguments.summary: A data exfiltration attempt was detected from workstation WS-FIN-019 (10.0.4.19) in the Finance department. The endpoint used DNS tunneling via high-entropy TXT queries to the domain ns1.exfil-c2.example.com, resolving to 203.0.113.77. Correlation revealed prior Cobalt Strike C2 activity from another Finance endpoint (WS-FIN-042) communicating with the same domain. Despite detection, containment actions (firewall block, EPP isolation, user disable) were denied due to policy or targeting issues. No malicious payload was confirmed in sandbox analysis of related artifacts, but behavioral and network patterns strongly indicate adversarial activity. The incident is assessed as critical due to sensitivity of accessed data and confirmed C2 infrastructure linkage.

timeline.description: External IP 203.0.113.77 observed conducting Nmap SYN scan against internal IT host WS-IT-101 (10.0.2.15). Logged by IDS.
Endpoint WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) initiates HTTPS connection to 198.51.100.23, associated with Cobalt Strike C2 activity.
IDS alerts on Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 activity from WS-FIN-042 to 198.51.100.23. DNS query to suspicious TLD also observed.
Lateral movement detected: WS-FIN-042 successfully accesses SMB share on file server 10.0.5.50.
Data exfiltration alert triggered: WS-FIN-019 (10.0.4.19) sending 2.3GB via DNS tunneling to ns1.exfil-c2.example.com (203.0.113.77).
SIEM correlation identifies historical C2 and lateral movement from WS-FIN-042. Domain ns1.exfil-c2.example.com linked to prior malicious activity.
Containment actions (firewall block, EPP isolation, user disable) attempted but denied due to policy or targeting misalignment.

arguments.rule_content:
title: DNS Tunneling via High-Entropy TXT Queries to Known Malicious Domain
id: 7a9b8c2d-1f4e-5a6b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d
description: Detects DNS TXT queries with high entropy subdomains directed at domains previously associated with C2 or exfiltration.
status: experimental
author: SOC Team
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1071/004/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1048/003/
logsource:
    category: dns_query
    product: network_sensor
detection:
    selection:
        query_type: TXT
        query_containing: '*.*.exfil-c2.example.com'
        subdomain_entropy|gt: 3.8
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate use of dynamic DNS with high entropy (rare)
level: high

rule Suspicious_DNS_Tunneling_Client_Process {
    meta:
        description = "Detects processes commonly abused for DNS tunneling (e.g., iodine, dnscat)"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1071.004"
        date = "2026-04-10"
    strings:
        $iodine_exec = "iodine" fullword ascii
        $dnscat_exec = "dnscat" fullword ascii
        $dns2tcp_exec = "dns2tcp" fullword ascii
    condition:
        $iodine_exec or $dnscat_exec or $dns2tcp_exec
}
